title: CredentialingWorkflow
description: Represents the credentialing workflow data stored in the data JSON field.

externalId.description: Entity responsible for credentialing the provider.

practitionerFileType.description: Type of practitioner file associated with this credentialing workflow.

credentialedStates.description: States involved in the credentialing process.

assignments.description: History of assignment changes for this workflow.

assignedBy.description: User or system that made the change.

assignedByDisplayName.description: Display name for assignedBy, enriched on GET; not persisted on replace.

assignedToDisplayName.description: Display name for assignedTo, enriched on GET; not persisted on replace.

assignedFromDisplayName.description: Display name for assignedFrom, enriched on GET; not persisted on replace.

lineOfBusinessChangeLog.description: Array to track changes to the practitioner's line of business. The actual lineOfBusiness data is stored in practitioner.lineOfBusiness on the workflow.

changedFrom.description: Previous line of business value (comma-separated string or empty string).

changedTo.description: New line of business value (comma-separated string or empty string).

createdBy.description: User ID of the user who made the change.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the change was made.

practitionerFileTypeChanges.description: Tracks practitionerFileType changes, with the most recent value always at index 0.

fileType.description: Type of practitioner file associated with this credentialing workflow.

changedBy.description: User or system that made the change.

credentialingCycleChangeLog.description: Tracks credentialingCycle changes, with the most recent value always at index 0.

credentialingCycle.description: Cycle of credentialing the provider after the change.

createdBy.description: User or system that created the change log entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the change log entry was created.

statesToCredentialChangeLog.description: Tracks states to credential changes, with the most recent value always at index 0.

reason.description: Reason for the states to credential change.

statesToCredential.description: States involved in the credentialing process after the change.

createdBy.description: User or system that created the change log entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the change log entry was created.
